route_b1_penalty_clamping.flaw_identified: Element-local penalty multiplies stiffness by element degree (4x on quad patch) and creates artificial off-diagonal coupling unless shape-function projectors are globally unified.

architectural_conclusions.reason: An element in Abaqus UEL only evaluates element-level matrices AMATRX(NDOFEL, NDOFEL) and RHS(NDOFEL). A shared node receives contributions from all incident elements. Local trial projection without global assembly knowledge violates equilibrium and complementarity.
architectural_conclusions.viable_solution: Global Nodal Communication via COMMON Block in UEXTERNALDB/UEL. By sharing a global nodal reaction array and nodal active-set mask in COMMON /CB_NODAL_PDAS/, elements can evaluate whether a node is globally active and apply unified row-orthonormalization, or an external driver orchestrates multi-job step progression.
